'''March 2002 Booster Pack Games tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Booster Pack Games (formerly Broken Games) on 23 March 2002. It is known from Greg Otte's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3539">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-27-booster-pack-games-03-23-2002d3539/ booster-pack-games-03-23-2002], DeckTech (Greg "Rogue 9" Otte, 27 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-27-booster-pack-games-03-23-2002d3539/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 March 2002
* '''Site:''' Booster Pack Games (formerly Broken Games)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 8
